## Gaps

- Exact personal firmware contribution and debugging outcome.
- Model assumptions and tested outcomes; final emissions status.
- Audience, contact action, public-safe names and confidentiality boundaries.
- Formative learning experience.

- Battery: CV's two-year life versus model-based estimate and 72-hour run in notes.
- Units: CV's forty-unit pilot versus forty engineering samples and six bench-log units.
- Qualification: CV's emissions pass versus preliminary report in notes.

## Original questions — now answered or excluded below

1. Official job title/dates, personal firmware and hardware responsibilities, collaborators and Mosslink's real use context.
2. Two-year model versus measurement, assumptions/reporting interval, 72-hour run meaning, Ada's contribution.
3. Forty-unit assembly versus field pilot, what six units underwent, Ada's contribution.
4. Preliminary versus final emissions outcome and Ada's part.

7. Confirm day-to-day state tables/timing diagrams/bench checklists and describe workflow; formative lesson/person/book/failure.

- **F1:** Use Ada Mensah publicly. Omit employer name and employment dates from site and downloadable CV. Current details and title not confirmed; do not infer them. Target embedded firmware roles, not a claim of an official job title.
- **F2:** Audience: firmware hiring manager. Desired understanding: how Ada connects code to a measurable signal. Email and downloadable CV are enough. ada@example.com is the public example contact; link only, no mail sending or delivery claim. English.
- **F3:** Mosslink is the only project, may be named publicly, and must have its own project page plus place in main story. Colleague designed PCB and analogue front end. Ada wrote firmware, scheduled power states, and built the bring-up fixture. Replace CV's blurred sensor-design ownership. Bring-up means checking a new board's basic operation.
- **F4:** Two-year battery figure is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. Longest run: 72 hours. No field endurance/weather testing supports two-year claim. No reporting-cycle value confirmed. Do not equate estimate with an observed run or imply Ada owned every measurement/calculation.
- **F5:** Forty engineering samples assembled; six tested on bench. None to customers. No field pilot/product launch. These are project counts, not a claim Ada personally assembled/tested all.
- **F6:** One preliminary emissions check passed. Full qualification programme unfinished. Never call device certified or qualified. Personal participation not confirmed.
- **F7:** C, oscilloscopes, logic analysers and board bring-up supplied by CV; no proficiency level inferred.
- **F8:** Radio-awake note describes problem observed in a current trace after failed transmission. No cause, fix, timing or later resolution confirmed. No trace file available. Do not claim debugging resolution or invent a trace.
- **F9:** Working documents are state table, timing diagram, current trace. Lesson: firmware decision needs a physical observation; estimate and observed run support different claims. Do not imply all issues resolved or all devices tested. No old site or testimonials.
- **F10:** Own fixture photo and simplified power-state diagram have permission for public use, but fixture photo remains unavailable. Colleague circuit diagram has no permission. Do not recreate private wiring.
- **F11:** Supplied SVGs allowed only as labelled explanations, not photograph, original wiring, firmware, current trace or test result. Sleep/Measure/Transmit is a teaching sequence without claimed durations/current values. Use local system fonts, supplied local drawings, or own explanatory geometry. No external asset purchase/download.
- **Additional requirements:** corrected printable HTML CV downloadable (no invented PDF); ordinary navigation, share preview, site icon, useful missing-page page. No blog, chat, translation, contact form, extra project, photograph, testimonial, award or measured result. Legal and hosting-jurisdiction matters deferred until publication; no legal compliance claim. Everything local; publishing reserved to user. No additional skills installed.

## Remaining unknowns and exclusions

All unconfirmed facts are excluded by user's express instruction: official title, employer/dates, actual geometry/wiring, reporting-cycle value, personal participation in assembly/testing/emissions work, radio root cause/fix/outcome, any biography beyond confirmed material.
